errors.text_span: 仅在最后的“Unaspirated”属性上略微下降到约0.8
errors.evidence: The green line (Monolingual-Ch) does not drop to 0.8 at "Unaspirated". Its value remains above 0.9, at approximately 0.92.

errors.text_span: 随后下降，在“Half L”达到最低点约0.25，然后上升，在“Back”处达到约0.7
errors.evidence: This description of the blue line (Monolingual-En) is overly simplified. It omits a major spike at "Low" (to ~0.58), a second major dip at "Central" (to ~0.23), and fails to mention that the final rise continues past "Back" to its highest peak at "unrounded" (at ~0.8).

errors.text_span: 黄线在大部分属性上高于或等于橙线
errors.evidence: This is an over-generalization. For a significant portion of the chart, from the "Central" to the "unrounded" attribute, the orange line is consistently higher than the yellow line.

errors.text_span: 两者都在“Half F”和“Central”之间出现小幅下降
errors.evidence: The drop for both the yellow and orange lines occurs before "Half F" (i.e., between "Front" and "Half F"). In the interval between "Half F" and "Central", the lines are relatively flat or even slightly increasing.
